items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Alma Turner was the soubrette. ... Alma Turner kept us at the Gram Terrace. Alma Turner cussed Ed Fox out

ctx.x: Later on, in some of these tapes from before, you said he came to you and asked your advice about it.

Yes, because we had a big stinkeroo in '39. We was at the Paramount Theatre. But going back to this particular year, 1936, which was right after July - all at once we figured out a way to get Basie moving into East and booked him into the Grand Terrace, because Bennie Moten was supposed to go in the Grand Terrace and Bennie died. When Basie took over the band they said we'll bring Bennie in to follow Fletcher Henderson and Earl Hines, into the Grand Terrace, which we opened and closed the same night, at…
